subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the secops owner approve this batch of 13 executable GitHub Action revisions for the token-bearing, CodeQL, Docker-publishing, repository-automation, and Codex workflows after the final exact-head checks complete?
rationale: Source review can establish that the patch is revision-only and the upstream commits are legitimate, but accepting newly executed third-party code in secret-bearing workflows is an explicit repository security-owner decision.

options.title: Approve the verified batch
options.body: After the final rebase and green exact-head gates, approve all full-SHA revisions together to keep the action fleet current and internally consistent.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates into smaller PRs if secops wants narrower rollout and failure attribution.

options.title: Pause the dependency refresh
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until a specific upstream revision or affected workflow can be investigated further.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified batch
recommendation.body: After the final rebase and green exact-head gates, approve all full-SHA revisions together to keep the action fleet current and internally consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The team is the explicit CODEOWNERS reviewer for the security-scanning and dependency-guard workflow surfaces in this batch.
